result.title: EgoHSI3R: Online 4D Hand-Scene Interaction Reconstruction from Egocentric Video
result.summary: Egocentric videos offer an abundant source of hand-scene interactions for embodied learning, which requires recovering hands, camera, and scene consistently in a shared 3D world. Existing methods focus on either camera-frame hands or world-space hand trajectories, without jointly recovering the scene pointmaps or interaction information. Building a complete reconstruction from such specialized predictions therefore typically requires per-sequence optimization. We propose EgoHSI3R, a unified feed-forward framework for online 4D hand-scene interaction reconstruction from egocentric monocular video. To jointly recover these components, it maintains a recurrent scene representation that accumulates geometric evidence over time and provides a shared world space and scale. We introduce hand-centric prompts that fuse pretrained hand priors and local scene context, while MANO vertex queries attend to scene features to predict dense per-vertex contact. These designs enable a single network to jointly estimate camera motion, dense scene geometry, world-space bilateral MANO hands, and per-vertex hand contact. Despite operating causally, EgoHSI3R achieves the lowest world-space hand joint error on ARCTIC among the evaluated methods, while offering faster inference than existing world-space hand reconstruction pipelines and competitive camera and scene reconstruction accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EgoHSI3R，一个从第一视角单目视频因果、在线地联合重建相机运动、稠密场景几何、世界坐标双手 MANO 及逐顶点接触的 feed-forward 框架，核心是随时间累积几何证据的循环场景表示与手部提示查询。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「循环场景表示持续累积视觉证据 + 用任务查询读取场景特征」的结构，可供核查作为 VLM 推理中持久视觉工作区与证据筛选、更新机制的架构线索，但与推理期语言侧 latent 状态无直接联系。
